name: @jungho-dev/fs-mcp

tools.name: get_configs
tools.description:
Get configuration values by key.
Omit items to return the full supported config surface.
Batch same-kind operations into one call.
For large arguments, pass a UTF-8 JSON file via {"args_path":"ABSOLUTE_PATH_TO_ARGS_JSON"}.

args_path.description: Path to a UTF-8 JSON file containing the complete arguments for this tool.

args_length.description: Optional character length to read from args_path.

tools.name: set_config_values

args_path.description: Path to a UTF-8 JSON file containing the complete arguments for this tool.

args_length.description: Optional character length to read from args_path.

tools.name: read_files
tools.description:
Read files in parallel.
Use paths for simple reads or items for offset, length, headers, or URL reads.
Set allowMissing true to return missing local paths as non-error missing results.
Batch same-kind operations into one call.
Use absolute paths. Relative paths depend on the current working directory.
For large arguments, pass a UTF-8 JSON file via {"args_path":"ABSOLUTE_PATH_TO_ARGS_JSON"}.

allowMissing.description: When true, missing local paths are returned as non-error missing results.

args_path.description: Path to a UTF-8 JSON file containing the complete arguments for this tool.

args_length.description: Optional character length to read from args_path.

content_path.description: Read UTF-8 content from this file. Preferred for large generated or pasted text.

content.description: Inline text accepted. For very large generated or pasted payloads, content_path or args_path can still reduce transport overhead.

instructions:
Use fs-mcp for local filesystem, process, git, and config work.
Batch-first rule: when one task needs multiple file, directory, search, process, or config operations of the same kind, put every item into one fs-mcp tool call instead of calling the same tool repeatedly.
